PluginData.Author: DrummDrumm
PluginData.Tooltip: Dock camera, Docking Assist screens and docking guidance for any connector, with an API for other plugins and mods.
PluginData.Description:
Protogen Systems Docking Solutions helps you dock: a full-screen dock camera with guidance (target brackets, approach corridor, range, closing speed, offset, alignment and the next step), and the "DOCK - Docking Assist" LCD script (any LCD, cockpit or seat screen) with an approach view, tunnel, scope and gauges.
Optional while docking: a picture-in-picture dock camera, steering from the camera (W flies the way it looks) and a docking dampener that limits the speed your keys ask for. All in the settings window (Pulsar plugin list).
Works with any connector, vanilla or modded: one with [Dock] in its name is picked first, one with [NoDock] never. Chat: /dock on | off | next | target | offset | map | theme.
A mod message API gives other plugins and mods the docking figures and the Assist sprites. Client-side only: nothing extra is sent to the server. Steering from the camera and the dampener only change the move and turn input your seat already sends.
